source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.142

dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: every public item whose record mentions jep.142, associahedra, Loday realizations, diagonal maps, polytopal subdivisions, normal fans or Tamari, the retired-claims list, the preparation worklist, and the geometry scouting selection/block notes for this source. No global novelty claim.
compared: public 2039 (same source): counted unit Theorem 1 / thm:MainOperad, statement lines 1303-1309 and proof 1311-1337 - existence of the nonsymmetric operad and of compatible diagonal maps. It neither states nor implies equivalence of subdivisions of normally equivalent polytopes.

prepared A-2039-associahedral-magic-formula (same source, state published): counted unit thm:MagicFormula with the two-step matching-face proof (statement 1343-1380; proofs 515-755, 833-1044, 1390-1660). That is an explicit cellular formula for standard Loday realizations; Prop:NormalFan is stated for arbitrary normally equivalent positively oriented polytopes and its proof never uses the matching-face classification. Some lines of that published proof region are reused here only as declared prerequisite context (def:Diag 895-937, coherent-subdivision construction 970-992, def:Coherent 1011-1016); the counted statement and proof of this task are outside all A-2039 spans.

public 1792 'Permutree fans are normal fans of explicit deleted-inequality permutreehedra for arbitrary four-type decorations' (doi:10.5802/alco.1, Theorem 3.4): a normal-fan realisation theorem proved by ancestor/descendant counts and rotation adjacency; it has no pair of normally equivalent polytopes, no diagonal map and no subdivision equivalence.

public 201338 'The Syntax Of Polytopal Projections: From Permutohedra To Associahedra' (arxiv:2605.25229, lem:f-word-normalization): a word-normalisation lemma about polytopal projections, with different objects and a different conclusion.

public 198918 'Higher rank Gelfand-Kapranov-Zelevinsky fans' (arxiv:2604.20250, thm:gkz:complete): existence of a polytopal subdivision in a GKZ setting, without tight coherent subdivisions, orientation vectors or diagonal maps.
